## Program and intake

## Proposed change

State the smallest exact fact that should be added, corrected, or marked uncertain.

## Rule classification

- [ ] Confirmed official eligibility
- [ ] Working MVP eligibility rule
- [ ] Recommendation-model assumption
- [ ] Verification required against the current admission advertisement

Do not strengthen a rule beyond the exact evidence.

## Source evidence

- Exact source URL:
- Source title or section:
- Source type: current advertisement / program page / handbook / other
- Last verified (`YYYY-MM-DD`):
- Applicable admission year:
- Exact criterion supported, in your own words:

Use an official Sukkur IBA University source where possible. Do not paste long copyrighted passages; quote only the minimum needed and summarize the rest.

## Conflicts or uncertainty

Does another official page, older document, workbook row, or working MVP rule disagree? Explain the conflict. If unresolved, the product must say verification against the current admission advertisement is required.

## Pre-Medical impact

Explain whether this affects the working rule that Pre-Medical students are eligible for every included non-engineering program and are not eligible for BE Electrical Engineering or BE Computer Systems Engineering.

Missing Mathematics must not automatically make a Pre-Medical student ineligible for a non-engineering program under the working MVP rule.

## Checklist

- [ ] The URL is exact and accessible.
- [ ] The verification date is included.
- [ ] The source applies to the stated intake, or that uncertainty is explicit.
- [ ] I did not convert a model weight into an official prerequisite.
- [ ] I did not claim that guidance guarantees admission.
